title: [finding] check-widening-tells T1 is still blind to FILE-LOCAL declaring factories — a new writable key through `placeholderFree(` on objectstack's own judged surface passes a `Clause-②: no` in silence
body:
**Class a** — reproducible defect, probe named. The sibling of #18560, left open by its own PR on purpose.

## Probe (run by the #18560 dev at PR #18700's head `7f1a81419`; the seat's reading of the report, the probe is one command)

A one-line diff adding

```
+  snapshotPath: placeholderFree(z.string(), 'persistence.snapshotPath').optional(),
```

to `packages/spec/src/data/driver/memory.zod.ts`, judged with `node scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs --declaration no --diff FILE` on the default board, exits 0 with the file JUDGED (not NOT-MEASURED) and zero tells. That is a genuinely new author-writable key passing a `no` in silence — the same class as #18560, on this repo's own surface.

## Why PR #18700 does not close it

PR #18700 repairs the vocabulary as a NAMED list of shared, exported helpers (`SCHEMA_PROPERTY_FORMS`, two registers, every form pinned by a counterfactual fixture). A list of shared helpers cannot name a factory private to one file, and its header refuses a name-shaped heuristic (`*Refusal(` / `*Arm(`) because it would recognise lines on evidence they do not carry. What closes this class is a reading that resolves the factory's own value, which is a different mechanism and a different card. The header of `check-widening-tells.mjs` at that head carries the overturn condition and names the populations below.

## Measured populations

At objectstack `6dfa3ea77`: `placeholderFree(` 23 key lines, `strictIdent(` 12, `INLINE_CREDENTIAL_REFUSED(` 10, `ruleArrayFilterError(` 10, `objectBlockHistory(` 9, `emptyProps(` 9, `belongsInConfig(` 8, `strictIdentOrNull(` 8. At objectui `15f01223d`: `chatbotRequestBodyArm(` 2 (and three siblings), `retiredDeclarativeKanbanKey(` 1.

## Remedy shape (the successor's)

Resolve a key line's value through the factory's OWN definition when the factory is file-local (the file is in the diff's tree, so its body is readable at the judged head), and classify by what that body returns — a `z.never`/refusing predicate declines, anything else is a writable key. Keep the shared-helper list as the fast path. Pin with the same counterfactual shape #18700 uses: one fixture per file-local factory, both arms.

## Provenance

Raised by the #18560 dev (report 5717123702, class a); filed by the skills seat. Dedupe words: check-widening-tells vocabulary, file-local declaring factory, SCHEMA_PROPERTY blind spot, placeholderFree, T1 key-line recognition. Checked against the 533 open issues at 15:10Z: #18560 (shared helpers, closing via PR #18700), #18640 (T1/T2 on options-object lines), #18629 (the `z.unknown()` reverse direction) and #18488 (`matchingCloser` −1) are neighbours; none is this.
